EXAMINATION DETAILS
Procedure: Contrast-Enhanced CT Chest, Abdomen, and Pelvis (IV contrast administered).
Clinical Indication: Staging evaluation for newly diagnosed right breast carcinoma.
Technique: Axial helical acquisitions obtained from lung apices through ischial tuberosities with reconstructed coronal and sagittal
reformations.
TECHNICAL QUALITY & RADIATION DOSE
Dose-length product (DLP): 680 mGy*cm. Quality: Diagnostic, no motion artifacts.
ORGAN-BY-ORGAN PRELIMINARY OBSERVATIONS
Lower Neck / Thyroid: Visualized thyroid gland is unremarkable without nodules.
Mediastinum & Hila: No pathological lymphadenopathy detected in mediastinum or hilar stations.
Pleural Spaces: No pleural effusions or pleural thickening identified bilaterally.

DETAILED ANATOMICAL FINDINGS
Breast & Chest Wall: 2.2 cm discrete non-calcified mass in upper-outer quadrant of right breast. Underlying pectoralis major muscle plane
is preserved without direct invasion. Left breast unremarkable.
Lungs: No focal lesions in lung parenchyma. Tracheobronchial tree is clear.
Abdomen: Liver is normal in size and attenuation; no focal lesions. Spleen, pancreas, adrenal glands, and kidneys unremarkable.
Pelvis: Bladder and pelvic organs unremarkable. No pelvic free fluid. No pathological lymphadenopathy detected in retroperitoneum.
Bones: No focal destructive or blastic lesions in osseous structures.
IMPRESSION & DOCUMENTED TEXT ANCHOR
Imaging report states: 2.2 cm discrete non-calcified mass in upper-outer quadrant of right breast. No focal lesions in lung parenchyma,
liver, or osseous structures. No pathological lymphadenopathy detected in mediastinum or retroperitoneum.
